metadata.task: Transport the television remote without placing it on the floor.

plan.goal: Transport the television remote from its initial location to a non-floor surface (e.g., TV Unit) without placing it on the floor.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the location of the television remote.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at Main Entrance. Remote is at Living Room on TV Unit.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the pose adjacent to the Television in the Living Room.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_001 allows navigation to the pose of a detected or named object. The robot uses this to reach the Television where the remote is located.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Detect and recognize the television remote.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the pose adjacent to the Television. Remote is present but not semantically identified.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has detected and recognized the object as 'remote'.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill PER_001 detects objects in the sensor field of view. The robot scans the area around the TV to find the remote.
Skill PER_005 assigns the semantic identity 'remote' to the detected object based on visual features.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Estimate the pose of the television remote.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot has recognized the remote but lacks precise 3D pose data.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has the 3D pose of the remote in the camera frame.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill PER_009 estimates the 3D pose of the recognized object using depth or geometry data.

checkpoints.entry_state: Robot knows the pose of the remote. Remote is resting on the TV Unit.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_001 executes a grasp and pick action using MoveIt2 to secure the remote in the gripper.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the TV Unit surface.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the remote. Robot is at the pose of the remote.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is positioned directly above the TV Unit surface.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_001 moves the robot to the location of the TV Unit to prepare for placement.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the remote on the TV Unit.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the remote and positioned above the TV Unit.
checkpoints.exit_state: Remote is placed on the TV Unit. Robot is holding the remote.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_002 moves the held object to the target pose on the TV Unit and releases it.

constraints: Robot has no visual perception (cannot detect objects).

execution_summary.failure_reason: The task requires navigation ('navigate_to_object') and object detection ('detect_object', 'recognize_object'), which require capabilities 'can_navigate', 'can_detect_objects', and 'has_visual_perception'. The robot H2 lacks these capabilities (fixed_base, no_visual_perception, no_detect_objects). Therefore, the plan cannot be executed.
